purpose: Validate local data ingestion, preflight, scoring, and backtest mechanics. It is not an investable universe or a CSI300 historical study.

selection_method.population: Intersection of the two direct 300-member anchors; 219 symbols.
selection_method.ordering: Ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 literal 'aiq-controlled-sample-anchor-intersection30-v1:' plus symbol.

known_biases: Membership at the 2024 anchor is used to construct the sample, so it has survivorship bias.
The sample is a static universe and does not represent CSI300 membership on any historical day.
Any measured return is suitable only for regression and pipeline checks, not investment or benchmark claims.
